purpose: Original source images for an attributed in-game reference atlas and production visual study; no image pixels changed.

assets.subject: Dark Spores Cavern
assets.provenance: Animated-series still, Wiki file URL found by image search; direct article access blocked.
assets.visual_observations: Dense forest of branching dark trunks and giant mushroom canopies. Turquoise cap undersides, muted red/orange cap rims, blue-green ground, purple atmospheric depth. The lower foreground is much darker than luminous middleground; broad organic shapes read before fine texture.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Image file and indexed page identify Dark Spores; do not relabel it Wild Spores or assume every forest cavern looks the same.

assets.subject: Pyrite Cavern
assets.provenance: Animated-series still, Wiki file URL found by image search; direct article access blocked.
assets.visual_observations: Wide cool-blue cavern with stepped platforms, tall cyan waterfall curtains, a massive fragmented arch/structure, dark hanging ceiling silhouettes and sparse violet/green flora. Small group figures establish monumental scale.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Asset attribution is Pyrite Cavern. No inference that its blue stone is ice, nor that the central form is a shipwreck without episode/source confirmation.

assets.subject: Shane Gang: Eli Shane, Trixie, Kord, Pronto
assets.provenance: Broadcaster ABC iview episode thumbnail, actual still found by image search; image caption not accepted as independent lore.
assets.visual_observations: Four clear silhouettes: Pronto is short and broad with mauve skin, moustache, blue/white striped shirt and orange scarf; Trixie is slim with auburn side hair buns, green top and gray trousers; Eli has dark hair, black/orange top, blue trousers and a side blaster; Kord is very tall/broad with blue skin, dark vest and oversized spotted metal bracers. Cyan slug canisters recur across their equipment. The backdrop has stylized tree/cavern structures and teal haze.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Scene/location caption from image search is not treated as verified lore. This is a broadcaster still suitable for appearance/relative-scale reference, not evidence of character stats.

assets.subject: Burpy / Infurnus protoform
assets.provenance: Disney-hosted legacy official Slugterra arsenal; exact image path appears in page HTML.
assets.visual_observations: Warm orange upright slug, two tapered horns, large paired black-and-white eyes, yellow flame-shaped forehead and belly marks, small side appendages. Curved silhouette and facial expression remain clear at small size.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Named as Burpy and Infurnus by official arsenal HTML; do not substitute an arbitrary red fire creature.

assets.subject: Doc / Boon Doc protoform
assets.provenance: Disney-hosted legacy official Slugterra arsenal; exact image path appears in page HTML.
assets.visual_observations: Green upright slug with one large horizontal eye, long thin paired antennae, pale green face/belly, darker green sides, tiny side appendages and a slightly asymmetric grin.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Named as Doc and Boon Doc by official arsenal; green coloration alone does not establish elemental taxonomy. Official page calls the element Light and power type Healing.

assets.subject: Joules / Tazerling protoform
assets.provenance: Disney-hosted legacy official Slugterra arsenal; exact image path appears in page HTML.
assets.visual_observations: Vivid cobalt-blue slug with pale cyan belly, lightning-shaped yellow horn/brow marks, large paired eyes, two prominent white fangs and small yellow belly spots.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Named as Joules and Tazerling by official arsenal; retain lightning horn geometry rather than generic round antennae.

assets.subject: Burpy / Infurnus transformed
assets.provenance: Disney-hosted legacy official Slugterra arsenal; exact image path appears in page HTML. Do not label as megamorph without further evidence.
assets.visual_observations: Transformed orange flying/charging silhouette with pointed facial/horn accents, pale yellow underside and a strong orange-yellow flame envelope. Expression and eye design connect it to protoform Burpy.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Official source marks this as transformed artwork. Asset is not independently verified as a megamorph; keep that label separate.

assets.subject: Eli's Blaster official toy reference
assets.provenance: Current official Slugterra product image; toy finish and proportions are product reference, not an exact animation model.
assets.visual_observations: Compact asymmetric orange/blue/gray blaster with cylindrical cyan canister, circular segmented chamber, short barrel, gray pistol grip and blue star motif.
assets.uncertainty_notes: Current official toy photo; plastic finish and product proportions should not be mistaken for exact in-show model geometry.

source_limits: Direct Fandom articles returned HTTP402; exact Wiki image URLs returned HTTP200. Named cavern attribution is secondary/indexed; visual observations come from actual image inspection.
Legacy Disney-hosted profiles are official promotional/game-era evidence, not a universal show/game taxonomy.
Official toy photography establishes a product appearance, not exact animation-model geometry.
classification_limits: Rarity labels are preserved verbatim from legacy source: no spawn probabilities, numeric prices, or universal ranking inferred.
Power type and element are separate. Boon Doc is Light element with Healing power.
Project combat roles, skill costs, cooldowns, currency rewards, and discovery placements are original balancing choices.
